english_title: Proposition 1.5.1: Pointwise Convergence at Points of Continuity
statement_en:
Let $f\in L^{\infty}(\mathbb{R}^n\to \mathbb{R})$, and let $\{K_{\lambda}\}$ be an approximate identity. If $x_0\in \mathbb{R}^n$ is a point of continuity of $f$, that is, $\lim_{x\to x_0}f(x)=f(x_0)$, then
$$\lim_{\lambda\to \infty}f*K_{\lambda}(x_0)=f(x_0).$$
